title: Vienna march against femicide and gender-based violence

tea.why: Demonstrators protested against high rates of femicide and patriarchal violence in Austria.
tea.want: Protesters demanded an end to femicide and effective protection for women against violence.
tea.changed: Nov 25, 2026: Hundreds marched through central Vienna from Mariahilfer Straße to Resselpark.

summary: Hundreds of people demonstrated in central Vienna on November 25, 2026, to protest against gender-based violence and femicide. The march coincided with the start of the international 16 Days against Violence campaign. Participants gathered in the evening at Mariahilfer Straße and marched along several city streets to Resselpark, chanting slogans against patriarchal violence and calling for an end to femicide. The demonstration took place amid reports by women's organizations highlighting an increase in femicide cases in Austria during 2026 compared to the previous year. More than a dozen police vehicles were deployed to temporarily block traffic along the march route.
response: More than a dozen police vehicles temporarily blocked streets along the demonstration route to manage traffic.
